# Immutable Crate headless SDK

Source: NakliTechie/crate at 813d079a2db2b810d231f04146626af20e053b42.

The source manifest pins every transitive module and the upstream license.
The host imports one immutable revision. Historical vendors remain available.
Bounded reads refuse unsupported compressed objects or non-BYOB transports.
This SDK does not advertise atomic expected-content mutations.
Remote publication requires separate verification before delivery.
